en: This is a black and white vintage postcard showing the interior view of a spa or healing spring. The image features a group of men, women, and a child gathered around a spring structure, each holding glass cups, suggesting that they are drinking mineral water from the spring. The room is tiled with simple, geometric decorative patterns and has large windows letting in light. The text at the bottom identifies the place as 'Bad Driburg, Kaspar-Heinrich Quelle Innenansicht', which translates to 'Bad Driburg, Kaspar-Heinrich Spring Interior View'. The reverse side has no correspondence, but includes a stamp from the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont' and publication information.
